findings.detail_zh: 启动前仍无runtime、工作树和TEMP卷空间预检；加入可配置余量及提交预算，低空间或检查异常禁止调用runner，覆盖多卷模拟测试。
findings.detail_en: There is still no prelaunch free-space gate for runtime, worktree and TEMP volumes. Add configurable headroom and commit reserve; low space or inspection failure must prevent runner invocation, with multi-volume mocked tests.

findings.detail_zh: 恢复模块未接线：要求schema2/token/process_identity/tree_state，但现行锁只含pid/started_at；exclusive不参与recovery guard。不能将新文件视为有效锁恢复。先实现统一互斥协议与进程实例/关联树生命周期证据，旧锁保持拒绝；添加PID重用、存活后代、恢复并发测试。
findings.detail_en: Recovery is not integrated: it requires schema2/token/process_identity/tree_state, whereas current locks contain only pid/started_at; exclusive does not participate in the recovery guard. Implement shared exclusion and process-instance/tree lifecycle evidence before enabling recovery; reject legacy locks and test PID reuse, surviving descendants and concurrent recovery.

findings.detail_zh: 未提交启动器输出异常含OUTPUT_LIMIT及cleanup_verified/cleanup_errors，但run_agent超时分支丢弃清理证据，cycle通用捕获只存类型。UNKNOWN仍禁止重跑，然而无法区分清理已证实与未证实。只序列化白名单reason/清理布尔及有界错误类别，禁止存异常正文；补端到端合成故障测试。
findings.detail_en: The uncommitted launcher exposes OUTPUT_LIMIT and cleanup_verified/cleanup_errors, but run_agent discards timeout cleanup evidence and cycle keeps only exception type. UNKNOWN still prevents retry, but verified and unverified cleanup become indistinguishable. Persist allowlisted reason/cleanup flags and bounded error classes, never exception messages; add end-to-end synthetic fault tests.

findings.detail_zh: 未提交启动器_Capture.read的finally直接close，close异常不进入capture.failure，真实线程异常可能退出后被当作清理成功；无读取线程时的直接close也可能覆盖主异常。纯内存复现close失败后capture.failure仍None。将全部关闭异常纳入清理错误通道并保持主异常，添加组合测试后再整合。
findings.detail_en: In the uncommitted launcher, _Capture.read closes directly in finally; close errors never enter capture.failure, so thread failure can be treated as clean completion. The direct close path with no reader threads may also mask a primary error. An in-memory reproduction leaves capture.failure None after close fails. Route every close error through cleanup reporting while preserving the primary exception, then add combined-fault tests before integration.

summary_zh: atomic_json写入加关闭补修通过限定独立审核；未知隔离、queue权威、按需receipt恢复及开发者恢复审核去重静态保留。整体可靠性未闭环，历史三文件不可直接宣称整合完成。
summary_en: The atomic_json write-plus-close repair passes scoped independent review; quarantine, queue authority, selective receipt repair and deduplicated developer recovery review remain intact on static inspection. Overall reliability is not closed; the three historical files cannot be claimed integrated.
